newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka May avg annual inflation down to 15.8pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka May avg annual inflation down to 15.8pct.

text.p: Sri Lanka'a May inflation, based on a 12-month moving average, fell to 15.8 percent from 16.4 percent in April, the Census and Statistics Department said on Monday.
The Colombo Consumers' Price Index (CCPI) for May rose 31.4 points to 2,047.4 from 2,016 in April, it said in a statement.
The CCPI rose mainly because of increases in prices of rice, corriander, lime, red onions, beef, pork, most varieties of fish, potatoes and most vegetables, it said.
But prices of sugar, dried chillies, coconuts, coconut oil, eggs and some varieties of dried fish fell during the month of May, the statement added.
